_name: probe-followups-split - the follow-up split on a rebuilt box
_why: Proves NESSIE_FOLLOWUP_ROUTING=split (the product default since c9e57058, routing review section 5) on a rebuilt box. An NExtSEEK-shaped follow-up (a breakdown, then a recall) stays on nextseek_query; a plot of the earlier result goes to container_cc; a self-contained question after NExtSEEK follow-ups is routed as in a new chat; and in a chat that used Container-CC a later 'of those' stays on container_cc although it is NExtSEEK-shaped, while a self-contained question in between still goes to nextseek_query. Route and route_source are asserted on every turn, numbers are pinned by _measure. probe-2026-09-23-followups-to-cc.json stays as the record of the rule before the split. Queries name no person.
_run: manage.py nessie --tier full --cases /app/NessieAI/tests/nessie_tests/probes/probe-followups-split.json --out /app/runs/split-<date> (copy the tree in first, NessieAI/tests/README.md 'Harness container lane'). 12 turns, 3 of them Container-CC (paid). With NESSIE_FOLLOWUP_ROUTING=cc the four NExtSEEK follow-ups go red on their route, which is the rollback check.
_instance_warning:
NUMBERS: NDMA 207 is fairdata-dev's (2026-09-23); every other number was measured on production on 2026-09-23. Each _measure entry says where. Re-pin before the run on any box:
  python NessieAI/tests/nessie_tests/scripts/pin_probe_truths.py --emit-cypher <this file>   (run the batch on the box, read-only)
  python ... pin_probe_truths.py --pin <this file> --from measured.json
Cases in mode 'each' list their numbers in the order of their locals.
The reject-73 guard on split.sticky_after_container_cc turn 4 is written by hand and does not re-pin.

followup_split.description: Multi-turn: NExtSEEK seeds, then follow-ups routed by the follow-up split (routing review 5).

variants.name: An NExtSEEK-shaped follow-up stays on nextseek_query: a breakdown, then a recall
variants._why: A breakdown of the earlier result by one field and a recall of the first search are follow-ups NExtSEEK can answer from the earlier result or by re-running its search, so under the split both stay on nextseek_query, decided by the router (route_source baml). 73 NHP with both flow and sequencing data; Macaca fascicularis 47, Macaca mulatta (Rhesus) 22, Macaca mulatta 4. Measured on production 2026-09-23 (also the workstation's numbers).

turns.label: seed
turns.query: Find NHP samples that have both flow cytometry data and sequencing data derived from them

turns.label: breakdown
turns.query: Which species are among those 73, and how many of each?

turns.label: recall
turns.query: Remind me how many NHP samples the first search found.

variants.name: A plot of the earlier result goes to container_cc
variants._why: A chart needs more than a re-run of the search, so under the split the follow-up goes to container_cc (the router, or the code guard on the word 'plot'), and an image file is written.

turns.label: seed
turns.query: Find NHP samples that have both flow cytometry data and sequencing data derived from them

turns.label: plot
turns.query: Plot the species of those as a bar chart.

variants.name: A fresh self-contained question after an NExtSEEK follow-up is routed as in a new chat
variants._why: The seed and its recall run on nextseek_query; the third message names its own subject and refers back to nothing, so the follow-up rule must leave it to the router. NDMA-treated mice: 207 on fairdata-dev (2026-09-23), 1,551 on production. HeLa samples: 4 (production 2026-09-23).

turns.label: seed
turns.query: Find me mice treated with NDMA

turns.label: recall
turns.query: Remind me how many mice that search found.

turns.label: fresh
turns.query: How many HeLa samples do we have?

variants.name: Sticky: after a Container-CC turn a later 'of those' stays on container_cc
variants._why: Turn 2 is a plot (container_cc). Turn 3 is self-contained and goes to nextseek_query as in a new chat. Turn 4 is NExtSEEK-shaped ('of those', a count) and refers to turn 3's HeLa result, but the chat already has a completed Container-CC turn, and NExtSEEK cannot see Container-CC's results, so it stays on container_cc. The answer is about the 4 HeLa samples (3 carry a treatment: HeLa-ActD, -GSK, -TSA), never the 73 NHP: on 2026-09-23 Container-CC bound 'those' to the wrong turn. The reject-73 guard is written by hand and does not re-pin.

turns.query: Find NHP samples that have both flow cytometry data and sequencing data derived from them

turns.label: plot
turns.query: Plot the species of those as a bar chart.

turns.label: back
turns.query: Of those, how many have a treatment recorded?

cypher: MATCH (n:T_NHP) WHERE EXISTS { MATCH (f:T_D_FLOW)-[:DERIVED_FROM*1..12]->(n) } AND EXISTS { MATCH (s:T_D_SEQ)-[:DERIVED_FROM*1..12]->(n) } RETURN count(n)
MATCH (n:T_NHP) WHERE EXISTS { MATCH (f:T_D_FLOW)-[:DERIVED_FROM*1..12]->(n) } AND EXISTS { MATCH (s:T_D_SEQ)-[:DERIVED_FROM*1..12]->(n) } RETURN n.Species AS species, count(*) AS n ORDER BY n DESC
